sentences.en: If your child drinks poison, rush him to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 如果孩子喝了毒药，赶紧送他去医院。

sentences.en: This poison is very effective in getting rid of roaches.
sentences.zh: 这种毒药对消灭蟑螂非常有效。

sentences.en: "What's your poison?" "Oh, give me a gin and tonic."
sentences.zh: "你要喝点什么？" "哦，给我来杯金酒和 tonic。"

senses.zh: 毒药；极有害的思想；抑制剂；中子吸收剂；有毒害的人（或行为等）
毒害；下毒；败坏；污染（地区、空气等）；抑制......的活性
